[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 98,490) above SMA5 (KRW 96,894), below SMA20 (KRW 107,485), and below SMA50 (KRW 123,585) — short-term attempt to rise, mid-term weakness.
· Below SMA100 (KRW 109,448), above SMA200 (KRW 87,202) — potential shift to mid-to-long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (51.2%) + current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.3→42.2) + attempting to exit oversold + potential shift to weak.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1541.4368→-428.6849) + improving diagnosis + signal of continued weak trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 88,635) + band width at 35.08% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 75,565) + based on Pivot S1 (KRW 77,750).
· Swing resistance (KRW 126,170) + similar to upper Bollinger Band (KRW 126,336).
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns (sideways) + lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.77x) + decreased reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + confirmation of wait-and-see conditions.
